title: Reports: Run, Filter and Export to CSV, Excel and PDF | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The reports of the CrestApps Contact Center and Omnichannel CRM answer questions about work that already happened: calls, queues, agents, campaigns and leads. This video shows how to find a report, set its date range and filters, and take it away as a CSV, Excel or PDF file.

In this video:
• Why reports, and what you do with each one
• Finding a report under Reports, by category
• Which reports each role sees
• The date range: relative days, calendar periods, rolling months and custom ranges
• Filters, including picking several dispositions at once
• Export to CSV, Excel (one worksheet per section) and PDF
• What a report says when the period is too long or a feature is off
